jtbd.jtbd_title: Essay sprint: outline → scenes → edit passes
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Stand up a repeatable essay system using scene bank, claim→proof mapping, and timed edit passes.

interactions.user_ask: How do I make my essays specific and alive?
interactions.jenny_reply: Build a scene bank: tiny moments with sensory detail; then map each scene to a claim.
Three: structure, clarity, and voice. Stop after pass 3 and ship.

outcomes.name: essay_system_v1
outcomes.details: Scene bank + claim map + 3-pass edit checklist.
